posts.text: I will begin twirling and will not stop until I trigger a hurricane

She said “it’s fucking hot outside deal with it”

I assume it was an incantation of some kind
If we are not good at empire building and regime change anymore then literally what am I supposed to be proud of this country for like…?

We can’t even do the one thing we were supposed to be good at

Not that we’ve ever *done a good job at regime change* but like what a faceplant

To be sure: the senate advancing a war powers vote does *not* suddenly end the war. There's further steps before it goes into effect, and even if it makes it across the finish line, I wouldn't start betting on this administration to suddenly begin following the law

Stay frosty, is all

Weather's doing that thing where it's outrageously hot and humid before a storm hits to bring down the temperature 

Except there's no storm in the forecast 

How do I fix this?

Mark Cuban showing solidarity through performance art that broke the hearts of libs who truly wanted to hold on to the notion that there exists an ethical billionaire 

They aren't billionaires because they went through life being a good person first and foremost

No LLM generated output should ever be trusted verbatim or used to speak in place of a human being, and yet that’s what the marketing and product design push on people

The way these things have been marketed should be a crime
(at the VERY least, listen to the last minute)

The Barenaked Ladies’ 1996 live recording of 'Brian Wilson' remains the GOAT and I haven’t been persuaded otherwise for at least 20 years

Daft Punk’s Alive 2007 live album is a close second, but the girl screaming in the crowd during Brian Wilson elevates that track to a solid 11
Insanely juicy this morning

This will now become my entire personality as I fight against this injustice
